name: testimonium
description: TESTIMONIUM Portal Suite — unified monorepo workspace for the Roman Catholic Diocese of San Carlos sacramental document processing system.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "Backend,Parishioner,Admin" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix testimonium-backend" "npm run dev --prefix testimonium-parishioner-web" "npm run dev --prefix testimonium-admin-portal"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:parishioner && npm run build:admin
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix testimonium-backend && npm install --prefix testimonium-parishioner-web && npm install --prefix testimonium-admin-portal
